about: Installed packages with a guide in kb/packages. The Fit-gap sub-agent (src/generators/emit-assessment.js) gives a package found in an org its business area, usual verdict and reason from here; any other package follows the method in kb/packages/README.md.

packages.name: Consumer Goods
packages.reason: Standard Consumer Goods Cloud package: keep, and check custom build around it against its standard objects

packages.name: Consumer Goods Mobile Sync
packages.reason: Required by the Consumer Goods Cloud offline mobile app

packages.name: Salesforce CPQ
packages.reason: End of sale, no new feature development; agree the roadmap (stay, or move to Revenue Cloud) with the business owner

packages.name: Salesforce Billing
packages.reason: No new feature development; Billing in Revenue Cloud is recommended. Agree the roadmap with the business owner

packages.name: Advanced Approvals
packages.reason: Documented with Salesforce CPQ; decide together with the CPQ roadmap

packages.name: Field Service
packages.reason: Standard Field Service scheduling and optimization: keep, and check custom scheduling code against work rules and recipes

packages.name: Salesforce Maps
packages.reason: Keep; check users of the standalone mobile app and Live Tracking Mobile, both retired on 31 August 2026

packages.name: Marketing Cloud Connect
packages.reason: Keep while Marketing Cloud Engagement is used; check the API user and tracking retention

packages.name: Account Engagement
packages.reason: Keep while Account Engagement is used; check for other syncs into the same records
